description.shortText: Automated gates is a self-service border clearance gates for travelers. The gates are equipped with multiple IOT enabled contact less devices such as iris scanner, palm vein scanner, RFID reader etc. to capture unique passenger data and an analytics engine that compares to collected data with multiple databases to verify the passenger identity.
